positions.title: Insurance Producer
positions.description: Create business and service clients in a self-managed environment. Have knowledge of the laws and stipulations that govern insurance in Missouri. Build and maintain relationships with businesses and clients in the area to generate a steady stream of leads and sources.

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description: Managed company’s daily cash flow and accounting. Assisted in roasting, packaging and marketing of coffee and espresso products. Supervised and trained sales associates.

positions.title: Financial Analyst
positions.description: Designed the Excel framework for the reports that Dodge now uses to discover weak areas and forecast future growth areas. Consulted the VP and co-led meetings concerning my data weekly.

positions.title: Resident Assistant
positions.description: Provided a supervisory role for a dorm building and its residents. Worked as a liaison between the Residential Life staff and students.

positions.title: Sales Manager
positions.description: Supervised and trained sales associates. Entered and analyzed daily sales data in Excel. Arranged mutually agreeable terms with customers to purchase their commodities with prices derived from the market.

positions.title: Server
positions.description: Responsible for taking care of multiple customers in a fast paced, think on your feet styled environment. Developed customer relations proficiency and learned an enormous amount concerning customer service and sales.

honors.title: The A.C.E. Award
honors.description: Awarded for best overall production in March 2017.
